Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision in
Conroe, Texas. Can you confirm you're comfortable being recorded?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Where were you sitting at the time of the collision?
A: I was in the front passenger seat. My friend was driving.
Q: Can you describe what was happening right before impact?
A: We were on the highway and my friend signaled to move into the left lane. A vehicle in that lane was coming up
fast. As we started to move over, that car clipped the side of ours. It pushed us toward the median and we spun a little
before stopping.
Q: Did either vehicle stop at the scene?
A: No, the other driver kept going. We got the plate partially, but not the whole thing.
Q: Tell me about your injuries.
A: My right knee hit the dashboard hard. It swelled up within an hour and I could barely put weight on it. I went to an
urgent care clinic that same day and they took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor.
Q: Have you been seen by a specialist since then?
A: Yes, I had an MRI and I'm now doing physical therapy twice a week. The doctor mentioned a possible torn
meniscus, but they're still evaluating it.
Q: Are you currently experiencing any limitations?
A: Yes. Stairs are difficult, and I've had to stop working my shifts on my feet. I'm still getting used to the brace.
Q: Thank you. Is tehre anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I want to make sure the other driver's information gets recorded properly, since they left the scene.
Q: Understood. Thank you for your time today.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
